notes: Pet type becomes clickable divs with no tabindex or role: not reachable by Tab, so the booking cannot be created by keyboard. Considered and rejected: axe-states (plain divs with click handlers violate no axe rule; if Kennel adds ARIA roles without required children, axe would flag aria-required-children and this golden needs revisiting), focus-visible (divs are not in the tab order), dead-control (clicking a div changes the DOM selection state), mouse-driven checks (options are still clickable). Also caught since 0.4.0 (error-announcement checks every field that shows an error after an empty submit, not only the ones marked required): the divs are not a form control, so "Choose a pet type." can't be tied to them (no aria-invalid, no aria-describedby) and only the live region's count ("There are 5 problems with your booking.") is announced; the clean radio group is wired and passes.
